QUOTE: "Approved if `auto_approve_tools` is set, or the call matches the allow list (`ServerManager::is_explicitly_allowed` → `PermissionManager::is_allowed`)." and "The allow list only affects approval; it never overrides the deny list."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the allow list only affects approval (not execution/deny), and that it is consulted from `check_approval` in tool_executor.cpp, with the deny check in server_manager.cpp.
